High Court Upholds Bail for Accused in Raja Murder Case

The Meghalaya High Court has ruled against canceling the bail granted to Sonam Raghuwanshi, the main accused in the Raja Raghuwanshi murder case from Indore. A petition seeking to revoke her lower court bail was dismissed. The police had argued for the cancellation due to the case's severity.
